meta.themes: FedRAMP AI, Agent Control Planes, Hyperscale Compute, Power & Capex

news.title: OpenAI secured FedRAMP Moderate for ChatGPT Enterprise and the API Platform
news.summary: OpenAI said FedRAMP 20x Moderate now covers ChatGPT Enterprise and the API Platform, opening a clearer path for U.S. agencies to use GPT-5.5-era models and future Codex access in regulated government workflows.

news.title: OpenAI said Stargate already surpassed its 10-gigawatt U.S. compute target years early
news.summary: OpenAI said Stargate has already cleared the 10GW U.S. infrastructure goal it originally set for 2029, with more than 3GW added in the prior 90 days as it expands data center and power site planning.

news.title: Anthropic revised its Responsible Scaling Policy with stronger outside review rights
news.summary: Anthropic's RSP Version 3.2 lets its Long-Term Benefit Trust request external reviews of Risk Reports, approve reviewer selection, and receive regular safety briefings as governance pressure rises with frontier model deployment.

news.title: AWS expanded its OpenAI tie-up with Bedrock model access, Codex, and managed agents
news.summary: At What's Next with AWS, Amazon said GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 are coming to Bedrock in limited preview alongside Codex on Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI.

news.title: AWS added AgentCore CLI and a managed harness to speed agent prototyping
news.summary: AWS highlighted new Bedrock AgentCore tooling including a managed harness for prompt-and-tool agent setup, an AgentCore CLI, and coding-assistant skills aimed at getting developers from idea to prototype faster.

news.title: Microsoft and OpenAI rewired their deal for multi-cloud flexibility and longer IP rights
news.summary: Microsoft said the amended partnership keeps Azure as OpenAI's primary cloud, makes Microsoft's model-and-product license non-exclusive through 2032, and lets OpenAI serve products across other cloud providers.

news.title: Microsoft said its AI business topped a $37 billion annual revenue run rate
news.summary: Microsoft reported fiscal Q3 revenue of $82.9 billion and said its AI business surpassed a $37 billion annual revenue run rate, up 123% year over year, with Azure revenue up 40%.

news.title: Microsoft moved Agent 365 into general availability as its agent governance layer
news.summary: Microsoft said Agent 365 is now generally available for commercial customers as a control plane to observe, govern, and secure agents, with added discovery for shadow AI and cross-platform registry support.

news.title: Meta backed space solar and long-duration storage to feed future AI data centers
news.summary: Meta said it reserved up to 1GW of space solar capacity from Overview Energy and up to 1GW/100GWh of ultra-long-duration storage from Noon Energy to support next-generation AI infrastructure.

news.title: Meta raised its 2026 capex forecast again as the AI build-out accelerated
news.summary: Reuters reported Meta lifted planned 2026 capital expenditure to $125 billion-$145 billion from $115 billion-$135 billion, underscoring how aggressively it is still funding AI infrastructure despite layoffs and cost pressure.

news.title: Alphabet said AI demand pushed Cloud revenue past $20 billion for the first time
news.summary: Sundar Pichai said Alphabet's AI investments are lifting every part of the business, with Google Cloud revenue up 63% to more than $20 billion and enterprise AI now acting as a major growth engine.

news.title: Samsung said AI memory demand drove a 49-fold jump in chip profit
news.summary: Reuters reported Samsung's chip division posted a 49-fold year-over-year profit jump as AI data-center demand tightened memory supply, and the company warned the supply-demand gap could widen further in 2027.
